name: Sofia Ramirez
bio:
Sofia Ramirez's journey into the world of motorsports began unexpectedly during her university years while studying engineering. A chance encounter at a local racing event ignited a passion that would define her career. After graduating, she initially worked as a data analyst for a smaller racing team, quickly demonstrating her knack for dissecting complex information and translating it into winning strategies. Her analytical skills and sharp decision-making caught the eye of 23XI Racing, where she now serves as a key strategist.

Sofia approaches her role with a blend of meticulous preparation and adaptability. She believes that successful strategy requires not only a deep understanding of the technical aspects of racing, but also the ability to anticipate and react to unforeseen circumstances. Her dedication to continuous improvement and her unwavering commitment to her team make her a valuable asset. What truly sets her apart is her ability to remain calm and focused under pressure, making her a dependable voice in the heat of competition.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with subtle waves and a side part.
physical.description: Sofia is a woman of average height with a warm, intelligent gaze.
